description: Read your Triple Whale metrics, attribution and SQL results, and send it orders, products, customers, subscriptions, ad and email figures, survey answers and offline events.

triple_whale_daily_summary_trigger.description: Runs once a day, soon after midnight in your time zone, with the day before's Summary Page metrics, such as revenue and orders. The first run is the day after the workflow is turned on.

output.date: The day the metrics are for (YYYY-MM-DD).
output.metric_values: Each metric's value, by its name, such as revenue.
output.metrics: Each metric's name and value, as Triple Whale lists them.

parameters.description: The time zone your days are counted in, such as America/New_York. Use your shop's time zone in Triple Whale. Leave blank for UTC.
parameters.name: time_zone

triple_whale_metric_threshold_trigger.description: Runs once a day, the first time a Summary Page metric for today, such as revenue, goes above or below a number you set. It checks every 10 minutes; if the metric is already past the number when the workflow is turned on, it waits for the next day.

parameters.description: The metric's name as Get summary metrics returns it, such as revenue or orders.
parameters.name: metric

parameters.description: above or below the threshold.
parameters.name: condition

parameters.description: The number to compare the metric with, such as 10000.
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.description: The time zone your days are counted in, such as America/New_York. Use your shop's time zone in Triple Whale. Leave blank for UTC.
parameters.name: time_zone

triple_whale_new_attributed_order_trigge.description: Runs for each new order in your shop once the Triple Pixel has attributed it, with the ad that first brought the customer and the pages they viewed. Orders placed before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.attribution: The attribution Triple Whale gives the order (firstClick).
output.first_click_source: Where the first click came from, such as facebook-ads.
output.journey: The pages viewed and carts added before buying.

parameters.description: Only orders whose first click came from this source, such as facebook-ads or google-ads. Leave blank for every order.
parameters.name: source

triple_whale_new_sql_row_trigger.description: Runs for each new row a SQL query on your Triple Whale tables returns, such as a new order or a new day of ad spend. Rows already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
triple_whale_new_sql_row_trigger.display_name: New row in a SQL query

output.key: The row's value in the Row ID column, if one is set.
output.row: The row, one value per column the query returns.

parameters.description: The SQL to run, with @startDate and @endDate where the period goes, as in the Run SQL query step. Only the first 1,000 rows are compared.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The column that tells rows apart, such as order_id. Leave blank to treat any change in a row as a new row.
parameters.name: key_column

parameters.description: How many days, up to today, the query covers: 1 (today, the default) to 31.
parameters.name: days

parameters.description: The time zone your days are counted in, such as America/New_York. Use your shop's time zone in Triple Whale. Leave blank for UTC.
parameters.name: time_zone
